preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The product of the lengths of s and t must not exceed 10,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s must consist only of small Latin letters and question marks.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t must consist only of small Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of occurrences of string t in the modified string s.
